name: Ambermill Investigations
summary: At Ambermill, Dalaran wizards weave magic that threatens the Forsaken’s hold on Silverpine Forest. From the Sepulcher, Shadow Priest Allister sends agents to disrupt their work and seize the magical foci.

sections.title: A Threat from the East
sections.body: Ambermill lies in the eastern hills of Silverpine Forest. Its human residents are wizards and defenders pledged to the Kirin Tor of Dalaran. The mages weave powerful magic in a vast ritual. At the Sepulcher, Shadow Priest Allister and his companion Dalar see the danger. If the Kirin Tor channel their power unchecked, the Forsaken risk losing Silverpine entirely.

sections.title: Disrupting the Weave
sections.body: As Dalar scries the forest and traces the magic, Allister sends agents against the practitioners in Ambermill. Dalaran conjurers, mages, and their protectors wear enchanted pendants that focus and coordinate their arts. Take the talismans from slain sorcerers, and the ritual falters. This buys the Sepulcher time to find the ringleader directing the arcane weave.

faq.q: Why is Shadow Priest Allister targeting Ambermill?
faq.answer: The Kirin Tor mages in Ambermill are channeling powerful arcane energies. Allister fears their spellcasting could cost the Forsaken control of Silverpine Forest.

faq.q: What are the Dalaran Pendants used for?
faq.answer: Dalaran conjurers, mages, and protectors wear the pendants to focus their craft. Taking them weakens the wizards’ efforts and helps Allister study the Kirin Tor’s magical progress.
Ambermill lies in the eastern hills of Silverpine Forest. From the Sepulcher, head south along the main road, then take the eastern fork into town.

faq.q: Who is Dalar, and how is he involved?
faq.answer: Dalar is a Forsaken practitioner at the Sepulcher who works with Shadow Priest Allister. He tracks the magic and seeks its sources, which fuel the Dalaran wizards in Ambermill.

faq.q: What happens after recovering the pendants?
faq.answer: The pendants reveal that a skilled wizard leads a Dalaran ritual already well advanced. Confronting that wizard is necessary to halt the spellcasting entirely.

faq.q: Why are Dalaran humans still in Silverpine Forest?
faq.answer: Before the Third War, Ambermill was a minor lumber town. After their kingdom was devastated, the surviving Kirin Tor took an interest in the town and still hold it against the Scourge and Forsaken.

angles.text: The Kirin Tor remnants in Ambermill are near the Undercity’s territory. Their magic threatens the survival of the Forsaken.
As a mage, you know a large arcane ritual demands precise coordination. Severing the Kirin Tor’s enchanted foci disrupts their spellcraft.
As a member of the Horde, you know holding Silverpine Forest protects Lordaeron’s western approaches from Alliance-aligned outposts loyal to Dalaran.
